verdict.rationale: Gram explicitly supports plugging in third-party/remote MCP servers (govern-a-third-party-mcp-server guide, custom remote and tunneled MCP sources, discovery via the official MCP Registry) and lets agents consume these as tools through a governed gateway, with verification, auth, and observability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and a customer case study (MoonPay), and no detail on limitations for unsupported/non-conforming MCP servers.
